replication.target_description: Experiment 1, low-frequency word n+1 stimuli from Yang et al. (2012), word n+2 single fixation duration (SFD); incorrect/dissimilar versus correct/identical preview contrast in a linear mixed-effects model; fixation-time outcomes log-transformed.

n.sample_role: Final analytic participants across England and China groups in the within-participant Experiment 1 model; not retained trial-observation count.
n.exclusions: 18 additional participants excluded for noticing more than three display changes. Trial exclusions: blinks in critical regions 14%, early display change 9%, display change >10ms after fixation onset 4%; 27% of data excluded overall. Exact retained trial count for each outcome not printed.

notes:
Identity verified from Edinburgh Research Explorer cover and manuscript title page: title, all seven authors, DOI 10.1080/23273798.2016.1197954, journal/volume/pages match the assigned replication reference. Document is the full peer-reviewed accepted manuscript (56 numbered pages plus cover), rather than an abstract or secondary report. No PDF path was supplied; layout evidence is canonical text only. Target matched by study/outcome and cited original identity: Experiment 1 Methods p.14 explicitly identifies the low-frequency stimuli as Yang et al. (2012); References p.45 identifies that work with the assigned original title and DOI 10.1007/s11145-010-9282-7 (input year 2010 versus reference year 2012). Therefore use the word n+2 Preview row in the low-frequency block, not high-frequency, word n, word n+1, or composite-region coefficients. The Table 3 block heading prints "Word n+2 Low Frequency", whereas Methods identifies the frequency manipulation as word n+1. Assigned p.9 locator does not correspond to accepted-manuscript pagination; results are pp.13–18 and Table 3 p.51. 40 final England participants + 40 final China participants = 80 final participants. Distinct location groups are mutually exclusive; all participants exposed to all conditions (footnote 2, p.46). The 18 additional excluded participants are not added. 80 is participant N, not the number of retained trial observations or items. To increase the normality of the data, the fixation time measures were

log-transformed. Printed coefficients retained without conversion; the precise contrast sign/order is not explicitly spelled out in the contr.sdif discussion and is not reversed here. Table 3 supplies b, SE, t (z for skipping), no numerical p column. The narrative non-significance is not converted into a p bound. Unassigned original and reported_success fields are placeholders. The printed metric label is b; no claim of standardisation beyond the documented log transformation is made.
